assets.name: Hourly weather
assets.scope: Gridded reanalysis at the commune coordinate, not a local weather station. Hourly values are interpolated to acquisition UTC.

assets.name: Optical cloud metadata
assets.scope: eo:cloud_cover of a Sentinel-2 tile intersecting the commune centre. Not commune-level cloud cover; no optical imagery redistributed.

assets.name: Moon disk and star field
assets.scope: Original procedural geometry. Stars are schematic, not an astrometric catalogue. No AI images or voices.

radar_reference: The existing commune radar mosaic is a fixed 27 October 2026 HH reference, not a time series. 3D object returns and speckle are illustrative.
narration: Optional user-supplied tour-en.mp3; absent by default. No synthetic voice is generated by the application.
